description: This is an Android Java source file defining a 'PlaylistFragment' class, which manages playlists in a music player app. It handles loading and saving playlists via SharedPreferences, creating new playlists through dialogs, and displaying playlists and their songs using RecyclerView components.

classes.name: PlaylistFragment
classes.description: Fragment managing user-created playlists, including their creation, display, and modification.

methods.name: loadPlaylists
methods.description: Loads playlists from SharedPreferences, deserializing JSON into a Map.

methods.name: savePlaylists
methods.description: Serializes the current playlists Map into JSON and saves it in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: showCreatePlaylistDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog to create a new playlist, adding it to the playlists collection.

methods.name: onPlaylistSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a playlist, opening its songs in another dialog.

methods.name: showPlaylistSongsDialog
methods.description: Displays the songs in a selected playlist.
